questions.question: What is the purpose of this video?
options: A) A movie trailer for Uncharted
B) A day in the life vlog on a film set
C) A cooking show about tea
D) A news report about Tom Holland
questions.explanation: 视频开头Tom Holland说'welcome to a day in the life of Tom Holland on the set of...'，明确表明这是一个拍摄现场日常生活的vlog记录。

questions.question: When Tom says 'Day 457', what does he mean?
options: A) It's been 457 days since he started acting
B) It's the 457th day of filming Uncharted
C) He woke up at 4:57 AM
D) His age is 457 months
questions.explanation: 结合上下文和后面提到的'wrapped day 732 of Uncharted'，可以判断'Day 457'是指电影Uncharted拍摄的第457天，用幽默的方式表达拍摄周期之长。

questions.question: What does the phrase 'my exes are as crazy as possible' imply?
options: A) His ex-girlfriends are mentally ill
B) He has had many unusual romantic partners
C) He doesn't have any exes
D) His exes are very calm people
questions.explanation: 这句话用夸张的方式暗示他的前任们都很特别/疯狂，是一种幽默的自嘲表达方式。'as crazy as possible'表示尽可能地疯狂。

questions.question: Which of the following is a common British informal greeting heard in the video?
options: A) What's up?
B) How are you doing?
C) You alright?
D) Howdy partner?
questions.explanation: 英国人常用'You alright?'作为非正式问候，类似于'你好吗'。视频中多次出现这种典型的英式问候方式。

questions.question: In the context 'He's not got one, he's got two', what is being compared?
options: A) Number of friends
B) Quantity of something he's holding/having
C) His age in different ways
D) Number of movies
questions.explanation: 这句'他没有一个，他有两个'是在描述某样东西的数量，通常用于指出某人拥有的物品数量比预期多。

questions.question: What does the slang expression 'pure shade' mean?
options: A) Complete darkness
B) A type of sunglasses
C) Subtle insult or criticism
D) A shadow effect in lighting
questions.explanation: 'Pure shade'是英语俚语，意思是'纯粹的嘲讽/暗中贬低'。'Shade'在这里不是指阴影，而是一种不直接点名但带有批评意味的评论，'pure'强调程度的强烈。

questions.question: In the phrase 'Go do some stunts or something', what is a 'stunt'?
options: A) A type of plant
B) An impressive physical action performed for a film
C) A quick meal
D) A style of dancing
questions.explanation: 在电影拍摄语境中，'stunt'（特技）指演员或替身演员完成的危险或高难度动作，例如视频中提到的吊绳、加农炮等动作场景。

questions.question: What does 'See you out there, mate' mean?
options: A) Let's go outside the building
B) Goodbye, I'll see you on set
C) Let's go on a trip
D) We will meet at a restaurant
questions.explanation: 'See you out there'是片场常用语，意思是'片场见'，指稍后在拍摄现场见面。'mate'是英式英语对朋友的称呼。

questions.question: What does it mean when someone is 'in charge of costume'?
options: A) They design the entire movie
B) They are responsible for the actors' clothing and wardrobe
C) They manage the catering
D) They handle the props
questions.explanation: 'In charge of costume'意味着负责管理演员服装的人，即服装部门的主管。他们确保演员的服装符合角色和场景需求。

questions.question: In film production, what does the abbreviation 'AD' stand for when referring to 'first AD' or 'second AD'?
options: A) Assistant Director
B) Art Department
C) Audio Director
D) Action Director
questions.explanation: 在电影制作中，'AD'是'Assistant Director'（副导演）的缩写。第一副导演（First AD）负责现场调度和演员管理，第二副导演（Second AD）则协助处理其他事务。

questions.question: What is the function of the repeated word 'bang' in 'Bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang, bang'?
options: A) It's a proper noun
B) It's onomatopoeia imitating gunfire sounds
C) It's an adjective describing excitement
D) It's a name of a person
questions.explanation: 'Bang'是拟声词（onomatopoeia），模仿枪声或爆炸声。重复使用是为了模拟连续的枪击声效，营造动作场景的氛围。

questions.question: What does Tom Holland mean by 'I don't know if I'm going to be able to do that guys'?
options: A) He is refusing the task
B) He is expressing uncertainty about completing a difficult action
C) He is asking for help
D) He is making a joke
questions.explanation: 这句话表达了对完成某项困难动作的不确定性和担忧，是演员在面对高难度动作前的常见反应。'I don't know if'是表达不确定性的常用结构。

questions.question: What does it mean that 'making tea is an art form'?
options: A) Tea is a form of paint
B) Making tea requires skill and is done with creativity
C) Tea can only be made by artists
D) Art teachers also make tea
questions.explanation: 'Art form'（艺术形式）指需要技巧、创造力和实践的技能活动。Tom用'泡茶是一门艺术'这种夸张说法来幽默地表达他对泡茶的讲究。

questions.question: Why is it significant that they bring tea bags 'from Yorkshire'?
options: A) Yorkshire is close to the filming location
B) Yorkshire tea is a famous British regional brand known for its quality
C) Yorkshire is where Tom Holland was born
D) Yorkshire tea bags are cheaper
questions.explanation: Yorkshire Tea（约克郡茶）是英国著名的茶叶品牌，以其优质和浓郁口感闻名。演员自带茶叶这个细节体现了对英式茶文化的坚持和自豪感。

questions.question: How would you describe your own tea or coffee making habits in English? Do you have any special routines or preferences?
questions.explanation: 这是一个开放性口语问题，参考Tom Holland关于泡茶习惯的讨论。学生可以描述自己是否有特殊的饮品制作习惯。
questions.referenceAnswer: 示例：'I always make my coffee in the morning with a French press. I add just a little bit of milk, no sugar. For me, the way the coffee is brewed really matters - I think making coffee is also a kind of art form, just like how Tom Holland talks about making tea. I usually have my coffee while reading the news.'
questions.hint: Think about: When do you drink it? How do you prepare it? What do you add to it? Do you have any special habits?

questions.question: In the context 'I feel like Homelander', what is Tom Holland referring to?
options: A) A character from the TV show 'The Boys' who is a powerful superhero
B) His co-star named Homelander
C) A real person he admires
D) A type of military uniform
questions.explanation: Homelander是热门美剧《The Boys》（黑袍纠察队）中的主角，一个强大的超级英雄角色。Tom Holland用这个比喻来表达自己在某个场景中感到强大或特别的感受。

questions.question: What does 'an obscene amount of people' mean?
options: A) A small number of well-dressed people
B) An extremely large number of people, more than expected
C) People who are obscene in behavior
D) A specific number of fifty people
questions.explanation: 'Obscene amount'是一个夸张表达，意思是'多得离谱的数量'。'Obscene'原意是'淫秽的'，但在此口语中表示'过分、荒唐'，强调数量多得令人难以置信。

questions.question: In filmmaking, what does 'Did we get it?' mean?
options: A) Did we receive the package?
B) Did we successfully capture the shot?
C) Did we understand the scene?
D) Did we get the script?
questions.explanation: 在片场，'Did we get it?'是一个经典问题，询问是否成功拍到了满意的镜头。如果答案是否定的，导演会说'No, let's do it again'，这正是视频中发生的情况。

questions.question: What does it mean in filmmaking to 'wrap' a day?
options: A) To wrap a gift
B) To finish filming for the day or a project
C) To wrap the equipment in cloth
D) To wrap up food for lunch
questions.explanation: 在电影行业，'wrap'是专业术语，意思是'完成当天的拍摄工作'或'杀青'。'We've just wrapped day 732'意为'我们刚刚完成了第732天的拍摄'。

questions.question: What does 'That was a typical day for us' imply?
options: A) It was an unusual day
B) Every day on set is similar to this
C) It was the first day of filming
D) It was the last day of filming
questions.explanation: 'Typical day'（典型的一天）意味着这只是他们日常工作的一个代表，说明这样的工作节奏和内容对他们来说习以为常。结合上下文，这暗示了Uncharted拍摄的漫长和辛苦。

questions.question: What does the idiom 'a lot of laughs' mean?
options: A) Many jokes were told
B) It was a very enjoyable and fun time
C) People were laughing loudly
D) There were many comedians on set
questions.explanation: 'A lot of laughs'是英语习语，意思是'非常有趣/愉快的时光'。它不仅指实际的欢笑，更表达整体的愉快氛围。视频中'fun'和'laughs'连用强调工作的乐趣。

questions.question: Imagine you are ending a vlog about your daily life. How would you sign off in English?
questions.explanation: 参考视频结尾'I hope you enjoy the film'的收尾方式。学生需要学习如何用自然的方式结束vlog。
questions.referenceAnswer: 示例：'And that's it for today's vlog! I hope you enjoyed watching a day in my life. Thank you so much for joining me, and I'll see you in the next video. Don't forget to like and subscribe!'
questions.hint: Consider: A greeting, a summary of what viewers saw, a thank you message, and a closing remark. Use phrases like 'I hope you...', 'Thanks for watching...', 'See you next time...'

questions.question: Practice introducing yourself and your daily life in English, just like Tom Holland did at the beginning of the video.
questions.explanation: 模仿视频开头Tom Holland介绍自己和工作的方式。学生练习自我介绍和描述日常生活的英语表达能力。
questions.referenceAnswer: 示例：'Hi everyone, welcome to a day in my life! I'm [name], and I work as a [job]. Today I'm going to show you what a typical day looks like for me. I usually start my day at [time], and I'll take you through everything I do - from morning routines to evening activities. Hope you enjoy!'
questions.hint: Include: 1) A greeting, 2) Your name and what you do, 3) A brief preview of what viewers will see, 4) An invitation to watch
